actions.added_meaning: Selected exact House floor 112206 EITC number-definition and separate Purple Heart increase boundaries follow. House floor 112206 separate Purple Heart increase: In the case of a specified Purple Heart recipient, the credit otherwise determined under subsection (a) for the taxable year shall be increased (whether or not such specified Purple Heart recipient is an eligible individual) by the sum of the SSDI benefit substitution amounts with respect to qualified benefit termination months during such taxable year. House floor 112206 specified Purple Heart recipient conditions: For purposes of this subsection, the term `specified Purple Heart recipient' means any individual-- (A) who received the Purple Heart, (B) who received disability insurance benefit payments under section 223(a) of the Social Security Act, and (C) with respect to whom such disability insurance benefit payments ceased to be payable by reason of section 223(e)(1) of such Act. House floor 112206 qualified termination months and reinstatement exclusion: For purposes of this subsection-- (A) In general.--The term `qualified benefit termination month' means, with respect to any specified Purple Heart recipient, each month during the 12-month period beginning with the first month with respect to which disability insurance benefit payments described in paragraph (2)(B) ceased to be payable as described in paragraph (2)(C). (B) Exception for months for which benefits are reinstated, etc.--Such term shall not include any month if the specified Purple Heart recipient receives any benefit payment under section 223(a) of the Social Security Act with respect to such month. House floor 112206 monthly substitution amount: For purposes of this subsection, the term `SSDI benefit substitution amount' means, with respect to any specified Purple Heart recipient for any qualified benefit termination month, an amount equal to the disability insurance benefit payment received by such recipient under section 223(a) of the Social Security Act for the month immediately preceding the 12-month period described in paragraph (3)(A). House floor 112206 increase-only limitation exceptions: Subsections (a)(2), (d), (e), (f), and (i) shall not apply with respect to the increase under paragraph (1).. House floor 112206 separate increase taxable-year-ending applicability: The amendment made by this subsection shall apply to taxable years ending after the date of the enactment of this Act. House floor 112206 number-definition amendment: Section 32(m) is amended by striking issued to an individual and all that follows and inserting (as defined section 24(h)(7)). House floor 112206 number-amendment taxable-year-beginning applicability: The amendment made by this section shall apply to taxable years beginning after December 31, 2024. The original complete 32(m) definition applies solely for 32(c)(1)(E) taxpayer/conditional-spouse identification and 32(c)(3)(D) qualifying-child identification. It originally required a SSA number other than the specified nonwork issuance clause (II)/related clause (III) portions, issued on or before the return filing due date. House replaces the text from issued to an individual onward with its printed (as defined section 24(h)(7)) cross-reference. Own same-bill 24(h)(7) instead retains citizen-or-specified-authorization SSA issuance and before the return due date, not the original on-or-before boundary or a blanket citizen-only/bare-number rule. No change is invented for the unchanged solely-for role limitation, taxpayer/spouse identification requirement or child name/age/TIN and permitted alternative information methods. Complete original 32(c)(1) keeps ordinary eligible-individual alternatives, no-child United States abode/age/dependency conjunction, qualifying-child ineligibility, 911 exclusion and nonresident-alien limitation with its own 6013(g)/(h) resident-treatment election exception; no blanket denial to every noncitizen. Full original 32(c)(3) retains own modified 152(c) reference without self-support paragraph (1)(D) or 152(e), married-child/United-States-abode/identification predicates and extended-active-duty context. Original full 32(d) separated-spouse conjunctions remain baseline, not newly enacted by this definition change or automatically waived for the ordinary credit. Other original income/table/investment limits and dated historical 2021 rules remain bound, not silently reset. The new Purple Heart increase is separately conditioned on receipt of the award and actual 223(a) disability payments that cease by reason of 223(e)(1); it is not a credit for every veteran or every person whose benefit ends. Complete original 223(a) benefit conditions and timing include own citizen/national and alternative authorized-number or temporary-business/crewman conditions, and 223(e) retains actual substantial-gainful-activity nonpayment after the third month during the 36-month post-trial-work period and related dependent-benefit rule. Those original benefit conditions are not replaced by 32(m), and no actual award/disability/payment/work/immigration status is inferred. The increase retains whether or not an eligible individual, own 12-month window, benefit-receipt-month exclusion, prior-month payment amount and only the listed (a)(2), (d), (e), (f), (i) exceptions applying to that increase. Whether and how ordinary eligibility/number clauses apply to that increase is reserved as question 60, not automatically full ordinary denial or universal exemption. Its taxable years ending after enactment differ from the number amendment taxable years beginning after December 31, 2024. Other EITC certification/task-force clauses stay full-source context rather than immigration conclusions. The served EH places the matching EITC body at 112205; its 112206 is Direct File. Floor preceding 112205 employee-retention-credit enforcement and adopted June correction witnesses are separately bound: the correction strikes that preceding floor section, and this candidate does not delete the EITC body by applying the same number to a later served version. Outer section labels, Record page labels, heading spacing and the split on-line token are comparison-only normalization; exact floor/EH bytes preserved, no full-EH vote-time equivalence. No Senate EITC amendment or component stance is inferred from this House-only source. Other H.R.1 components and separately reserved questions remain unfinished.
